decision: Which runtime should own the first production deployment of this agent workflow?
constraints: The workflow contract and published result must remain unchanged when the runtime changes.
The team needs a local development path and a customer-owned AWS deployment path.
The first production release should minimize operational uncertainty.
evidence: The workflow can run through a provider-independent agent slot.
Run lifecycle and published results use versioned contracts.
The local API exposes the run and its typed result to independent clients.
